key.name: toggle-overlay
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the layer overlay.

key.name: hud-enabled
key.description: Show the overlay while a layer other than the base layer is active.

key.name: hud-show-delay
key.description: How long a non-base layer must stay active before the overlay appears.

key.name: hud-hide-delay
key.description: How long to wait after returning to the base layer before hiding the overlay.

key.name: highlight-enabled
key.description: Highlight each key on the overlay while it is pressed.

key.name: position
key.description: Where the overlay is placed on the primary monitor; 'custom' uses the dragged position.

key.name: monitor
key.description: Connector of the monitor to show the overlay on (for example 'DP-1'). Empty means the primary monitor, which is also used while the chosen one is unplugged.

key.name: allow-dragging
key.description: Let the overlay be dragged with the mouse while it is shown. While enabled, the overlay receives clicks instead of letting them through.

key.name: custom-position
key.description: Where the overlay was dragged to, as fractions (0–1) of the free space in the work area. Used when position is 'custom'.

key.name: refresh-requested
key.description: Internal: incremented by the preferences to force a layout refresh.
